value.rationale: The result identifies the first competition between positive fourth-curvature and negative derivative energy in a natural measurable local pair-proximity statistic. Unlike the previously known cubic term minimized by circles, the fifth coefficient has no lower bound at fixed perimeter, with an exact 4-versus-5 Fourier frequency boundary across a nondegenerate family of actual embedded strictly convex curves. This gives a meaningful sharp boundary on interpreting local distance statistics as geometric regularity indices, beyond a routine Taylor coefficient.
